lines.text: David asks God to deliver him from his enemies when Saul sends men to watch his house to kill him.
David says fierce men lie in wait without cause, and asks God to show the wicked traitors no mercy.
His enemies return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling the wilderness, saying, "Who can hear us?"
David asks God not to kill them lest his people forget, but to consume them so Egypt knows God rules.
David will sing of God's strength in the morning, for God is his fortress and refuge in trouble.
